scroll_video_spec.codec: h264 High, yuv420p, bt709 tv-range tags, crf 14, no audio
scroll_video_spec.motion: hold top 0-1.0 s; scroll 1.0-7.5 s with 1.2 s raised-cosine ease in/out, peak 698 px/s (about 23 px/frame); settle 7.5-8.0 s
scroll_video_spec.end_frame: 'You know video works. Getting it right is the hard part.' heading with the first two problem cards
scroll_video_spec.method: full-page screenshot strip (header hidden) cropped per frame at integer px, sticky header pill re-composited from a transparent capture so it stays fixed like on a phone

notes: Site reachable; captured with Playwright 1.64 + /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194 (executable_path) at 390x844 CSS, DPR 2.769 -> 1080 px wide, iPhone UA. No cookie banner present. Page uses scroll-reveal (.rv) elements: the page was pre-scrolled so all sections are revealed before capture; fonts (Inter, Inter Tight) loaded. Only page animation is a one-shot 2.6 s 'snake' line draw in the hero (waited out) plus a frozen tools marquee; nothing essential, so the scroll was rendered from the screenshot (no stutter). Sticky header pill (#050f19, white WKC logo) is composited fixed on every frame. The hero showreel block shows its poster (3D cubes 'You / Competitor', 'You don't have what makes your competitors stand out.'). fullpage.png is 1080x40772 (stitched from 4 tiles to avoid the GPU texture limit; seams checked); the ClearScaler case video shows native player controls there. Logo is a single-colour hand-lettered 'WKC' SVG path (currentColor); the site shows it #f6f6f6 on the #050f19 pill, so logo.png is the light version (reads on dark: yes; on light: use logo_ink.png). Copy is quoted exactly; note the site's own typo 'Succesfull Collaborations + Partners' is visible in the scroll around 2-4 s. Site names co-founders Raphael Wind and Karl van Kessel. hero.png equals the viewport render (mean pixel diff 0.002).
